facts.fact: The NCSI profile (version 10 Aug 2023) cites a National Cyber Security Strategy 2021-2025 as the established national strategy.
The NCSI profile cites the Côte d'Ivoire Computer Emergency Response Team (CI-CERT) as the government unit specialised in national-level cyber incident detection and response.

The NCSI profile cites the list of critical sectors, sub-sectors and services in Annex 2 to Decree No. 2021-916 (RGSSI and Critical Infrastructure Protection Plan) as the legal act identifying operators of essential services.

note: Index rank, cooperation and drills not recorded.
